title.zh: Sing-box 规则集（Rule-Set）与智能分流实战：配置低内存占用、高性能路由分流引擎
title.en: Sing-box Rule-Set & Intelligent Routing: Deploying High-Performance, Minimal-Footprint Routing Engines

description.zh: 详解 Sing-box 独创的二进制规则集（.srs Rule-Set）编译与智能分流配置方案。手把手教你编写轻量化路由规则，实现国内 IP 毫秒级直连、海外 AI/流媒体精准出海与零内存开销。
description.en: Master Sing-box binary rule-sets (.srs) for blazingly fast routing decisions with near-zero RAM footprint. Configure split-tunneling policies for domestic bypass, AI tooling, and streaming services.
